browser.title: Sign in with your web browser
browser.description:
### 1. Open Sign-In on a Desktop Browser
*(Please use a desktop browser such as Chrome, Edge, or Firefox rather than a mobile device or app)*

Click the link below to open the sign-in page, and wait for it to finish loading:
[**Click Here to Log In with Sub-Zero**]({auth_url})

### 2. Capture the Redirect URL
1. Let the sign-in page **finish loading completely**. Only then open Developer Tools (press **F12** or **Ctrl+Shift+I**, or use the browser menu) and switch to the **Network** tab. Opening it earlier just fills it with page-load noise.
2. Enter your email and password, then click **Sign In**.
3. The page stays on the login screen. Depending on your setup you may see something like "Page Not Found" or "Unable to open address", or a box asking if you wish to open another application; just ignore any of these. The Network tab now shows only a few new rows; the last one, at the bottom, is red (it failed because desktop browsers cannot open the mobile app link).
4. Right-click that red row and choose **Copy** > **Copy URL**. It starts with `com.szg.szgdigitalproductexperience://oauth/redirect?code=...`
5. Paste the copied URL below and click **Submit**.

*(Alternatively, you can paste an existing refresh token or `subzero_tokens.json`)*
